name: abdm-portal
description: The ABDM Developer Portal: integration skills for ABDM integrators, and the contributor's assistant for building the portal itself

plugins.name: abdm
plugins.description: hiecm-m1-build and hiecm-m1-debug scaffold and debug an ABDM Milestone 1 (ABHA) integration, citing the Catalogue atom behind every call. fhir-generate and fhir-audit build or audit NRCES compliant FHIR document bundles, iterating against the Docs MCP validator until clean.

plugins.name: abdm-contributors-assistant
plugins.description: Build and operate the ABDM Developer Portal: atom authoring, verification, linting, OpenAPI ingestion, Scalar docs, skill compilation, the update pipeline, the support agent, planning and proof. Compiled from the architecture and execution plan in this repo.
